question: HR-336 (the pick Frontier subsession for great-hiker's prose work) runs great-hiker's prose on a frontier-tier subsession, which the 2026-10-20 rule (subagents on Opus medium) and kurapika.md's hard limit forbid. Which did you mean?

options.label: One exception (Recommended)
options.consequence: great-hiker's prose work is the one subsession allowed on the frontier tier; kurapika.md and the 2026-10-20 rule gain that single exception

options.label: Your own session only
options.consequence: Frontier only when the maintainer runs great-hiker; a delegated great-hiker stays on Opus medium
